assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation spritesheet for the original Greek roguelite Paradise in Hell. Reference image is ONLY identity/outfit/style reference: use the named class, correct bad poses, do not copy floating equipment. One transparent RGBA PNG, no floor, drop shadow, scenery, grid, labels, text or watermark. Crisp deliberate low-resolution pixel clusters, strong readable outline, NOT soft illustration. Adult Mediterranean mortal MAN, short dark beard, olive skin. Same head, body proportions, clothes and gear in EVERY cell. Weapons are firmly held in hands as part of the full-body illustration. No detached weapon layers. Class to depict: Caçador / hunter. Costume and equipment: ivory tunic, short deep-teal cloak, bronze open-faced crested helmet, leather sandals, ONE wooden recurve BOW held naturally, quiver on back. Canvas1536x1280. EXACT invisible grid SIX columns and FIVE rows. Row1 DOWN/south: front, both eyes and chest visible. Row2 UP/north: back of head and back of clothing. Row3 LEFT/west: true left profile, face and toes point horizontally LEFT. Row4 UP-LEFT/northwest: true45-degree REAR-left, back and left side visible, legs stride toward UPPER LEFT. Row5 DOWN-LEFT/southwest: true45-degree FRONT-left, BOTH eyes/face and chest visible, shoulders and feet point LOWER LEFT. Row5 must be clearly a FRONT diagonal, absolutely not a side-profile or rear view. Do not draw ANY right-facing rows; engine will mirror. SIX equally spaced frames of a smooth WALK cycle per row, alternating planted feet, continuous gait, not jumping. Keep the skull center and WAIST at exactly the SAME coordinates within all six cells: head center x50% y30%, waist center x50% y56%, soles around y82%. Head/torso stay stable, no left-right drifting, NO TELEPORTING, no body scaling, no changing camera, no exaggerated bounce. Animate legs and subtle arm/cloth follow-through. Body occupies central40% cell width and about64%height, weapon stays within10..90%cell. Every character fully inside its own cell.

Use case: stylized-concept. Correct the ATTACK DIRECTIONS of this original Guardian of Tartarus, maintaining charcoal armor, ornate bronze/gold edges, tall angular faceplate, violet mantle, massive pauldrons. One transparent PNG, pixel-art clusters, NO background, labels, grid or detached projectiles. Canvas1536x1280, EXACT SIX columns FIVE rows. Rows: DOWN, UP, LEFT, UP-LEFT, DOWN-LEFT. EACH row is six phases of a casting action: brace, draw fists in, gather purple magic, extend arm, CAST TOWARD THAT ROW'S DIRECTION, recover. The face, torso, extended hand and purple magic must ALL point in the SAME direction. LEFT row: arm and palm extend to the LEFT of body and glow is on LEFT edge, NEVER right. UP-LEFT row: arm/glow point UPPER LEFT and body seen rear-left. DOWN-LEFT row: arm/glow point LOWER LEFT and both eyes/chest visible FRONT-left, not side profile. DOWN row: both palms thrust toward viewer/bottom and glow BELOW chest, NOT off to either side. UP row: thrust away toward top, glow above head, body back visible. No right-facing art; engine mirrors left. Keep head/hips pivot fixed across phases, same character size and stable baseline. Empty hands except purple magic, no weapon.

NOT a skeleton, no exposed ribcage or skull. Production crisp pixel-art for top-down3/4 Greek roguelite Paradise in Hell, matching bronze/slate/teal palette. Top-down3/4 orthographic gameplay view, crisp readable pixel clusters, subtle stone texture, slate/bronze/ivory/teal palette. ONE truly transparent RGBA PNG, EXACT invisible2columns2rows. Looks like a functional shrine, not a chest, grave or abstract rectangle.
